subject: Standardize SSR length by repeat length

messages.author: 6a8f96be35217d76
messages.subject: Standardize SSR length by repeat length
parts:
Hi,

I'm working with perfect SSR repeats.
And I'm tired of wasting time to translate SSR PCR sizes (binned) to repeat units for downstream analyses, using PGDSpider. Pretty exhausting and error-prone, when working with many loci/Inds.

Can poppr help?!?
Is fix_replen() the magic I'm looking for?
Or are you familiar with any other package that can do that for me?

Any pointers would be great.
Much appreciated,
-Marcin

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Standardize SSR length by repeat length
parts:
Short answer: no.

Longer answer: no, but it may help. fix_replen() tweaks the repeat lengths to avoid rounding errors in division. It will tweak what it can and than give you a warning with a list of repeat lengths that it cannot correct. This will at least give you an idea of where you need to focus your effort.

I'm afraid that I personally do not know of any software for this off the top of my head.

I hope that helps.


Best,

Zhian
